item.description:
⚡ Codex answers in about a second now — no folder to trust, no interface to open.

✨ New

  • 🚀 Codex is read through its own background server instead of its /status
    screen. No trusted project, about a second instead of forty-five, and nothing
    is ever typed into Codex's prompt to get there.
  • 💳 A Codex workspace metered in credits finally shows a figure: the monthly
    budget becomes the headline, with credits used out of credits granted beneath it.
  • 🎚️ Warning and critical zones are set per provider, so Claude's 75% and
    Codex's 90% no longer have to be the same number.
  • 🆙 A waiting update shows up as a third button in the card's footer, next to
    Settings, and hovering it names the version. It used to sit quiet for a week
    before mentioning anything; now it is a day.
  • 📌 Pin the provider the pill carries straight from the card where all three
    stand side by side, switch providers from the title of the open panel, and get
    alerts in the pill itself — macOS is never asked for notification permission.

🔧 Fixed

  • 📊 Copilot's token counts and its activity dot work again. Copilot moved both
    into a new store, and the one this app was reading has had nothing written to
    it since 11 September, so the numbers had quietly frozen.
  • 🟢 The activity dot follows the sessions that are actually answering, instead
    of whichever log line was written last.
  • 🧹 Assorted panel fixes: a row no longer calls something a weekly cap on an
    account that has no weekly cap, and clicking outside the open panel closes it.

💬 Tell me what breaks: https://tokenpacer.com/#feedback
